title: Genome-wide identification and expression analysis of phytochrome gene family in Aikang58 wheat (Triticum aestivum L.).
authors: Yang, Zhu; Kan, Wenjie; Wang, Ziqi; Tang, Caiguo; Cheng, Yuan; Wang, Dacheng; Gao, Yameng; Wu, Lifang
one_liner_zh: 该文对小麦光敏色素基因家族进行全基因组鉴定与表达分析，虽用LASSO筛选转录因子，但核心是基因家族进化与表达，无蛋白质-DNA互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Phytochromes are essential photoreceptors in plants that sense red and far-red light, playing a vital role in regulating plant growth and development through light signal transduction. Despite extensive research on phytochromes in model plants like Arabidopsis and rice, they have received relatively little attention in wheat. In this study, we employed bioinformatics methods to identify eight TaAkPHY genes in the Aikang58 wheat variety. Based on gene structure, conserved domains, and phylogenetic relationships, the TaAkPHY gene family exhibits a high degree of conservation. Synteny analysis revealed the evolutionary history of the PHY genes in Aikang58 and Chinese Spring wheat (Triticum aestivum L.), barley (Hordeum vulgare L.), rice (Oryza sativa L.), maize (Zea mays L.), quinoa (Chenopodium quinoa Willd.), soybean [Glycine max (L.) Merr.], and Arabidopsis [Arabidopsis thaliana (L.) Heynh.]. Among these species, wheat is most closely related to barley, followed by rice and maize. The cis-acting element analysis indicates that the promoter regions of TaAkPHY genes contain a large number of CAT-box, CGTCA-motif, GC-motif, etc., which are mainly involved in plant development, hormone response, and stress response. Gene expression profiling demonstrated that TaAkPHY genes exhibit varying expression levels across different tissues and are induced by various stress conditions and plant hormone treatments. Co-expression network analysis suggested that TaAkPHY genes may specifically regulate downstream genes associated with stress responses, chloroplast development, and circadian rhythms. Additionally, the least absolute shrinkage and selection operator (LASSO) regression algorithm in machine learning was used to screen transcription factors such as bHLH, WRKY, and MYB that influenced the expression of TaAkPHY genes. This method helps to quickly extract key influencing factors from a large amount of complex data. Overall, these findings provide new insights into the role of phytochromes in wheat growth, development, and stress responses, laying a foundation for future research on phytochromes in wheat.
abstract_zh: 光敏色素（phytochromes）是植物中感知红光和远红光的关键光受体，通过光信号转导在调控植物生长发育中发挥重要作用。尽管在拟南芥和水稻等模式植物中对光敏色素进行了广泛研究，但在小麦中它们受到的关注相对较少。本研究采用生物信息学方法，在矮抗58小麦品种中鉴定出八个TaAkPHY基因。基于基因结构、保守结构域和系统发育关系，TaAkPHY基因家族表现出高度保守性。共线性分析揭示了矮抗58和中国春小麦（Triticum aestivum L.）、大麦（Hordeum vulgare L.）、水稻（Oryza sativa L.）、玉米（Zea mays L.）、藜麦（Chenopodium quinoa Willd.）、大豆[Glycine max (L.) Merr.]和拟南芥[Arabidopsis thaliana (L.) Heynh.]中PHY基因的进化历史。在这些物种中，小麦与大麦亲缘关系最近，其次是水稻和玉米。顺式作用元件分析表明，TaAkPHY基因启动子区域含有大量CAT-box、CGTCA-motif、GC-motif等，主要参与植物发育、激素响应和胁迫响应。基因表达谱显示，TaAkPHY基因在不同组织中表现出不同的表达水平，并受多种胁迫条件和植物激素处理诱导。共表达网络分析提示，TaAkPHY基因可能特异性调控与胁迫响应、叶绿体发育和昼夜节律相关的下游基因。此外，利用机器学习中的最小绝对收缩和选择算子（LASSO）回归算法筛选了影响TaAkPHY基因表达的转录因子，如bHLH、WRKY和MYB。该方法有助于从大量复杂数据中快速提取关键影响因素。总体而言，这些发现为光敏色素在小麦生长发育和胁迫响应中的作用提供了新见解，为未来小麦光敏色素研究奠定了基础。
